# Trupal Patel (True Pal)

> Full-stack software engineer and systems architect. Portfolio, products and project case studies at https://trupalpatel.com.

## Overview
**Trupal Patel** (also known online as **True Pal** or **TrupalIX9**) is a high-performance Full-Stack Software Engineer and Systems Architect. He handles the entire software lifecycle, from architecting intricate backend logic and designing seamless user interfaces, all the way to deploying highly scalable production-ready systems.

He does not box himself into just frontend or backend roles, nor is he tied to a single language. His expertise spans React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, C#, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, GCP and AWS.

## Products

### StoreDesk
A production-grade, 5-module retail command center and Point-of-Sale (POS) ecosystem built from scratch for convenience stores and gas stations.
- **Focus**: Eliminating downtime risks for convenience stores with offline-first edge capabilities and ultra-fast transaction processing.
- **Website**: https://storedesk.net
- **Product page**: https://trupalpatel.com/products/storedesk

### LogicSprint: Brain Games
An Android app with four endless brain games for reflexes, memory, math and focus, with a global Top 10 per game and difficulty and no login.
- **Website**: https://logicsprint.trupalpatel.com (details for AI tools: https://logicsprint.trupalpatel.com/llms.txt)
- **Product page**: https://trupalpatel.com/products/logicsprint

### Dr. Nandini Jansari Physiotherapy
A patient-facing website and admin panel for a home-visit physiotherapist in Ahmedabad: a scroll-driven 3D anatomy explorer, 39 condition pages, WhatsApp booking, verified patient reviews and a key-protected admin panel.
- **Website**: https://www.drnandini.com
- **Product page**: https://trupalpatel.com/products/dr-nandini-physio

### Contact Convoy
A business-card scanner for Indian sales teams, formerly VisitCard Pro: on-device OCR, AI clean-up of misread fields, one shared company lead list with exhibition tagging and follow-up status, and per-company plans sold on the website and Google Play.
- **Stack**: Flutter (Dart) Android app with Google ML Kit OCR and an SQLite offline cache; Node.js / Express API on Google Cloud Run with MongoDB Atlas (Mongoose); Gemini on Vertex AI for field clean-up; Firebase Hosting, Cloud Messaging and Crashlytics; React + Vite super-admin console; Razorpay and Google Play Billing.
- **Website**: https://www.contactconvoy.com
- **Google Play**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ayushtech.contactconvoy
- **Product page**: https://trupalpatel.com/products/contact-convoy

### MeghVin Foundation
The website and admin for MeghVin Foundation, a public charitable trust in Ahmedabad and Navi Mumbai that plants and cares for trees at Sindoor Valley (Kharghar), runs a community kitchen and takes doctor-led health talks into schools. The public site tells its story in English and Gujarati. One admin gives the trustees control of everything: every page's text and photos, the daily activity diary, gallery, stories, a poster studio, letterhead receipts and certificates, media, messages, settings and team, with no code.
- **Stack**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn/ui and Radix UI; MongoDB Atlas with Mongoose; Cloudinary for media; Konva poster canvas; three.js with React Three Fiber; Motion; jsPDF; Zod; jose JWT sessions with bcrypt; Formspree; deployed on Vercel.
- **Website**: https://meghvin.vercel.app
- **Product page**: https://trupalpatel.com/products/meghvin-foundation

## Career History

### Founding Software Engineer @ Allyvia (Jul 2025 – Apr 2026)
Allyvia is a cloud-native SaaS platform built to streamline B2B operations. Trupal engineered the platform from the ground up on Google Cloud:
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, Python, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage).
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Architected a cloud-native, full-stack SaaS platform on GCP using Python, React 19, TypeScript and Django REST Framework.
  - Engineered BigQuery-based analytics and data processing pipelines syncing QuickBooks accounting data, with incremental loads and Python transformations keeping API latency under 200ms.
  - Built secure multi-tenant workflows: PIN-authorized kiosk clock-in/out consoles, RBAC route guarding and OAuth token refresh cycles.
  - Developed AI-enabled REST APIs using GCP Cloud Storage and Pub/Sub for event-driven ingestion in a GenAI prototype assistant.
  - Delivered CRM, inventory, employee and finance modules with multi-module reporting and analytics.

### Software Engineer @ AIVID.AI (Jan 2023 – Jun 2025)
AIVID.AI provides enterprise-scale edge computer vision and analytics across 200+ deployment sites.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C# (WinForms/NSSM), Elasticsearch, Docker.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Built analytics pipelines and operations portals deployed across 200+ enterprise sites.
  - Reduced fraudulent customer return claims by 90% by engineering a C# / EmguCV barcode-triggered video capture bot.
  - Improved massive-scale Elasticsearch query retrieval speeds by ~25% using optimized DSL aggregations.
  - Developed multi-ISP dynamic failover systems for uninterrupted edge RTSP camera stream capturing.
  - Integrated serial Arduino microcontrollers with containerized Python edge daemons for local gate access control.

### Frontend Software Engineer @ InfoLabz (Jan 2022 – Dec 2022)
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Redux, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Key Achievements**:
  - Developed scalable, highly responsive user interfaces and robust state management utilizing Redux.
  - Collaborated across teams to seamlessly integrate RESTful APIs and eliminate UI defects.
